token: Existing one-use web.view token; take_request/report_page/finish remain broker operations
body: v2 must explicitly announce web.download.body.v1 via connectedCapabilities. Host reserves validated offer metadata and acknowledges via offerResult. Only accepted offers appear as {streamOfferId} in finish. One-use download returns reliable pipe; no refetch. Metadata sourceUrl is HTTPS provenance, never a fallback retrieval address. Basename <=200 UTF8 bytes, mime <=256, size -1 or <=64GiB. Unclaimed60s, stalled60s, total60min; host applies stricter job limits/free space. v1 never receives body callbacks.

navigation.url: HTTPS, no userinfo/control characters, at most 4096 characters
navigation.title: at most 512 characters

results: Only web.view.finish: approved-domain cookies, effective user agent, bounded HTTPS download handoffs; host validates scope and owns vault and transfers
browse: Unique Gecko private context; no cookie import/read/export, no UA/download export; HTTPS navigation event only at host
failure: Fallback only after withdrawUntaken; once taken, failure ends incomplete and cannot replay the token
ownership: surface returns SurfacePackage through AIDL return-value flags; setChildSurfacePackage takes ownership of accepted packages; host releases only rejected/late packages; provider releases SCVH/session on close or host death
